summary: Thomson Reuters filed a 6-K covering third-quarter 2026 results, disclosing the completed sale of a 51% stake in its Global Print business to capital accounts advised by KKR for gross proceeds of approximately $500 million, closing October 1, 2026. Global Print is now reported as discontinued operations, and full-year 2026 guidance was updated to exclude it (total revenue growth ~9.5%, organic ~8.5-9.0%, adjusted EBITDA margin ~39%). No per-share price or premium applies; no board recommendation or advisor was named. The company concurrently issued ~$2.0 billion of notes and completed a $600 million buyback. Watch for residual 49% stake monetization, use of proceeds, and margin re-basing.
